Exact Agent-facing delegation, approval, idempotency and result API compatibility remains to be tested; maturity is accepted as planning input, not independently certified here.
assumptions.model_services: User confirms existing locally deployed large models and DeepSeek. Reuse approved existing inference services and DSH adapters; no new inference engine, base-model deployment or training in scope. Exact versions, endpoint deployment boundaries, protocols, streaming tool behavior, capacity and data policies are not yet verified. Local deployment does not replace tenant authorization or allow silent external fallback.
assumptions.scope: One web workspace, bounded QASM subset, one simulator, one supervised QPU backend, one initial analysis template; later bounded representative extensions, not all algorithms or all devices. The broader v0.4 company-workplace coding sandbox, office sending and full knowledge publishing workflows have not been individually costed into these packages.

method: Sum the remaining effort ranges for included packages; add 20% to low and 30% to high; divide by engineers times 0.70; take the maximum of each rounded capacity estimate and the expert-assessed critical-path floor. Milestones are cumulative, not additive. Intervals are judgment ranges, not statistical confidence intervals.
